title: : PURITY - A MUST
verse: holy; for I am holy” (KJV) 1 Peter 1:15-16
body: : PURITY - A MUST “. be ye holy in all manner of conversation. Be ye holy; for I am holy” (KJV) 1 Peter 1:15-16 He called you. You never called yourself. And He who called you is an embodiment of holiness - so pure - He is the only One whose name and surname is Holy. “Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly. And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory” (KJV) Isa 6:2-3. “But be holy in all you do, just as God, the One who called you, is holy” (NCV). “But - in imitation of the holy One who has called you - you also must be holy in all your habits of life” (WNT). That’s it! Be an imitator of Him who called. With an irresistible style, TBCL declares, “As obedient children, let yourselves be pulled into a way of life shaped by God's life, a life energetic and blazing with holiness.” “For it is written, You shall be holy, for I am holy” (Amp). 1 Thess 4:7; Lev 20:7.
prayer: Dear heavenly Father, thank You for Your holiness and thank You for Your love to make me holy. I, thereby, ask for Your total cleansing for my spirit, soul and body in Jesus mighty name, Amen.

title: : THE DYNAMICS OF HOLINESS
body: : THE DYNAMICS OF HOLINESS “Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore. God, hath anointed thee. above thy fellows” (KJV) Heb 1:9 Loving dikaiosune and hating anomia attracts anointing. The Bible commands, “Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant. being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself. became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross. (KJV) Phil 2:5-11. Do you want real power in God? Purity is the pathway to power: The realm of power and anointing in which Jesus demonstrated during His earthly ministry was connected to His life of purity. Jesus said of Himself, “. for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me” John 14:30. If you must walk in the realm of great power and uncommon anointing, go walk in purity.
confession: Father, I want more - more of Your purity, more of Your righteousness and more of Your image - deeply rooted in me. Take away every root of self, sin and carnality that is limiting Your power in me. Let Your grace prevail in me.

title: : THE POWER THAT IS RESIDENT IN PURITY
body: : THE POWER THAT IS RESIDENT IN PURITY “Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. purify your hearts.” (KJV) Jam 4:8 You’re as close to the Holy Spirit as you choose it to be. Developing intimacy with the Holy Spirit doesn’t just happen accidently - you’ve to love it, desire it and crave for it. It is then and only then you can experience the reality of the presence and person of the Holy Spirit. You know what - your closeness determines His closeness. Holy Spirit is everyone’s friend and no one’s enemy. It’s the side you turn to Him He turns to you. He is ever ready to be your Best Friend, Close Associate, Senior Partner as long as you give Him chance. Honour Him daily, Eph 4:30. Love and esteem Him so highly. Be honest to Him always - don’t pretend - tell Him your true feeling - He will always help. Above all, keep away from resentment, hatred, bitterness, anger and the like. Value what He values. Be passionate with what He’s passionate about - tell others about Jesus - help those in need.
confession: I will love the fellowship of the Holy Spirit more than ever before - I will crave for more of His presence - I will develop a more intimacy with Him. And so, I grow in Your fullness and I manifest Your power freely.

title: : DEVELOPING FRIENDSHIP WITH THE HOL Y SPIRIT
body: : DEVELOPING FRIENDSHIP WITH THE HOL Y SPIRIT “Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength” (NIV) Mark 12:30 God wants all - not a part - of you. He wants your total being - all of your heart, all of your soul, all of your might and all of your strength - He desires YOU in your entirety! Love Him passionately and energetically. Amplified simplifies it! “And you shall love the Lord your God out of and with your whole heart and out of and with all your soul (your life) and out of and with all your mind (with your faculty of thought and your moral understanding) and out of and with all your strength. This is the first and principal commandment.” As you offer all of you freely, you enjoy all of Him cheaply. God wouldn't go for halfhearted service. He doesn’t go for lackadaisical commitment. He is never interested in leftover - He is interested in firstever. In every aspect of your life, consider Him first, Deut 10:12. Give all and use all - for His praise and pleasure - your skill, prestige, position and wealth.
confession: I surrender all - all of my will and way. I give You all of me - my heart, soul, body, possession and time. I leave all at the foot of the Cross. Reign in my life supremely - unhindered!

title: : HE W ANTS ALL OF YOU
verse: having done all, to stand” (ASV) Eph 6:13
body: : HE W ANTS ALL OF YOU “Wherefore take up the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and, having done all, to stand” (ASV) Eph 6:13 Prayer is the mainstay, lifeblood and backbone. “Redeeming the time, because the days are evil” (KJV) Eph 5:16. Redeem each second, minute and hour of the day. Bind the devil and all his activities. Release your spirit to respond to the things of the Spirit. “Therefore put on God's complete armor, that you may be able to resist and stand your ground on the evil day [of danger], and, having done all [the crisis demands], to stand [firmly in your place]” (Amp) Eph 6:13. You see that! Prayer is all inclusive weapon to resist and withstand in the evil days. “The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light” (KJV) Rom 13:12. “And besides all these take the great shield of faith, on which you will be able to quench all the flaming darts of the Wicked one; and take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit.” (KJV) Eph 6: 16-18.
prayer: Father, I ask for Your quickening power to keep my spirit alive for a dynamic prayer life and grant me inner strength in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : PRA YING AND LIVING TO PLEASE HEA VEN DAIL Y
body: : PRA YING AND LIVING TO PLEASE HEA VEN DAIL Y “The purpose of this order is to arouse the love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and a genuine faith” (TEV) 1 Tim 1:5 “. the love that comes from a pure heart.” is our central focus today. It’s not a mere flattery. It’s the kind that comes from the heart and touches the heart. A young man spent an entire evening telling a girl how much he loved her so dearly. He said sweet words like - he could not live without her and that he would go to the ends of the earth for her. He added sweetly, I will go through fire for you, or die for you. However, on leaving, he said, "I'll see you tomorrow night if it doesn't rain." How often we say we love God and yet deny it by our actions. Love is the key - it wins with all men. Does he/she prove to be so difficult? Your boss? Your spouse? Your child? Your neighbour? Your in-law? Your colleague? Try real true love. Rom 13:10 of TBCL says, “You can't go wrong when you love others. When you add up everything in the law code, the sum total is love.” Rom 13:10 “Love avoids doing any wrong to one's fellow man, and is therefore complete obedience to Law.” (WNT ).
confession: I stand out as a love practitioner, love demonstrator and love spreader.

title: : MARK OF PURITY - CHARITY
body: : MARK OF PURITY - CHARITY “Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience” (ASV) 1 Tim 3:9 The word conscience is found once in the OT and twenty-eight times in the NT. It is an inborn sense of right and wrong. Out of several kinds of conscience in the Bible, let’s carefully go through four of them. 1. “And Paul. said, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day” (KJV) Acts 23:1. That’s it! Good conscience. 2. “I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience” (KJV) 2 Tim 1:3. That’s a pure conscience. 3. “And in this I do exercise myself, to have a conscience void of offence toward God and men always” (YLT) Acts 24:16. Here comes another kind - conscience void of offence. 4. “Let's draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and having our body washed with pure water” (WEB) Heb 10:22. That’s another kind of conscience - evil conscience. How is your conscience? If your conscience has been evil in any way, seek for a cleansing, Heb 9:14.
confession: I will hold the mystery of faith in a clean conscience. Pure conscience shall be my goal each passing day before God and man.

title: : MARK OF PURITY - PURE CONSCIENCE
body: : MARK OF PURITY - PURE CONSCIENCE “But the wisdom that is from above is. peaceable, gentle, willing to yield, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality.” (KJV) Jam 3:17 The Bible commands, “Pursue peace with all people. without which no one will see the Lord” (NKJV) Heb 12:14. ESV says, “Strive for peace with everyone. without which no one will see the Lord.” The Psalmist gives a gallant directive, “. crave peace and pursue (go after) it!” (Amp) Ps 34:14. Rom 12:16-18 says, “Be in harmony with one another. Do not give evil for evil to any man. Let all your business be well ordered in the eyes of all men. As far as it is possible for you be at peace with all men” (BBE). Among those who exemplified peace was Abraham, Gen 13:8-9. The act of pursuing and striving for peace guarantees your own inner peace. It guarantees your good health [You can’t be at war and be at rest. War without triggers war within], Ps 133:1. Above and beyond, peace guarantees your final abode with God.
confession: I am an agent of peace. I create a peaceful atmosphere wherever I am found. I am for peace. God’s peace reigns supremely in my innermost being. Hallelujah!

title: : MARK OF PURITY - PEACEABLE
verse: full of mercy and good fruits.” (KJV) Jam 3:17
body: : MARK OF PURITY - PEACEABLE “But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits.” (KJV) Jam 3:17 It takes mercy to receive mercy. In an unambiguous style, the Bible declares, “With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful.” (KJV) 2 Sam 22:26. Mercy - not fasting - is the conveyor of mercy. Matt 5:7 says, “Blessed are the merciful, For they shall obtain mercy” (NKJV). The Amplified says, “Blessed (happy, to be envied, and spiritually prosperous - with life-joy and satisfaction in God's favor and salvation, regardless of their outward conditions) are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy!” Be merciful to all. If you can’t give a million, give a thousand; if you can’t give a thousand, give a naira; If you can’t give a naira, give your widow’s mite. “Clothe yourselves therefore, as God's own chosen ones (His own picked representatives), [who are] purified and holy and well-beloved [by God Himself.” (KJV) Col 3:12.
confession: As God's own chosen one - His own picked representative - purified and made holy [by God Himself], I am tenderhearted and merciful. I am full of mercy.

title: : MARK OF PURITY - FULL OF MERCY
verse: of mercy and good fruits.” (KJV) Jam 3:17
body: : MARK OF PURITY - FULL OF MERCY But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits.” (KJV) Jam 3:17 We are called to bear fruits as the mark of a pure life. “Even so, every good tree produces good fruit.” (WEB) Matt 7:17. The nature of Christ was transplanted in you when you surrendered to Him. He gave you a brand new life to bear brand new fruits. “Therefore if any person is [ingrafted] in Christ (the Messiah) he is a new creation (a new creature altogether); the old [previous moral and spiritual condition] has passed away. Behold, the fresh and new has come!” (Amp) 2 Cor 5:17. Old moral life is gone - you are altogether a spirit being, John 15:23. “Now we look inside, and what we see is that anyone united with the Messiah gets a fresh start, is created new. The old life is gone; a new life burgeons! Look at it!” (TBCL). Why the stealing, lying and ungodly practices? “And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts” (KJV) Gal 5:24. Read Eph 5:9.
confession: I am a fruit-bearing tree in Him. The fruit of the Spirit are functional in me - love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness and temperance.

title: : MARK OF PURITY - GOOD FRUITS
body: : MARK OF PURITY - GOOD FRUITS “Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works.” (NKJV) Matt 5:16 In an electrifying approach, the Amplified puts Matt 5:16 thus, “Let your light so shine before men that they may see your moral excellence and your praiseworthy, noble, and good deeds and recognize and honor and praise and glorify your Father Who is in heaven.” You’re of the light - to lighten - the darkness around you. You originated from the Father of Light. He wants you to shine for the world to see your moral excellence. TBCL says, “Now that I've put you there on a hilltop, on a light stand - shine! Keep open house; be generous with your lives. By opening up to others.” Stand tall! Stand sparkling! And stand shining! Our light must be a reflection of Christ. “And the light shineth in the darkness; and the darkness apprehended it not” (ASV) John 1:5. No one lights a lamp only to cover it up, but places it so as to give light to all who need light. So, Christians are to hold forth their light before men that they may know what true Christianity is all about. Read Isa 60:3.
prayer: With this revelation, dear Father, I will reflect Your character wherever I’m found. I’ll live for Your glory in Jesus precious name, Amen.

title: : LET YOUR LIGHT SO SHINE
body: : LET YOUR LIGHT SO SHINE “Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God” (NIV) Matt 5:8 Does the Bible say blessed? Yes, b-l-e-s-s-e-d [happy and glorious] are the pure in heart. Pureness, I must affirm, is a plus factor! Jesus spent His entire life preaching the kingdom lifestyle of righteousness and right living. “Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled” (KJV) Matt 5:6. “Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven” (KJV) Matt 5:10. “For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven” (KJV) Matt 5:20. “But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness.” (KJV) Matt 6:33. “. but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is. And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure ” (KJV) 1 Jn 3:2-3.
prayer: Father, thanks for Your numerous teachings on right living. By Your grace, I believe I can always live it right and I will always live it right in the precious name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : CHRIST'S TEACHING ON RIGHTEOUSNESS
body: : CHRIST'S TEACHING ON RIGHTEOUSNESS “Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us.” (KJV) Heb 12:1 Yooperistatos is the Greek for the words easily beset. It means skillfully surrounding or retard running. When the Bible speaks of easily besetting sin, it speaks of sin that has an advantage of easy prevailing. Casting your mind back to the time you were not saved, you committed all sorts of sin. One or more of those sins you were completely sold out to, sometimes, becomes that easily besetting sin(s). We’re not left in the dark as to how to rather prevail. The way to prevail is in apotithemi the Greek for the word lay aside meaning put off. This teaches you responsibility. This is done by declaring what the Bible declares and that easily besetting sin shall loose its grip over you. Ponder on Rom 6:14 and pray it through. With your wordbased declaration and watchfulness you win every battle against sin.
prayer: By the power in the precious blood of Jesus that was shed for me, I declare and decree my dominion over every easily besetting sin in the name of JESUS, Amen [Pray through].

title: : DEALING WITH EASIL Y BESETTING SIN
body: : DEALING WITH EASIL Y BESETTING SIN “But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment” (KJV) Matt 12:36 ERV goes, “I tell you that everyone will have to answer for all the careless things they have said. This will happen on the day of judgment.” CEV pinpoints this so clearly, “I promise you that on the day of judgment, everyone will have to account for every careless word they have spoken.” That you will give an account is no joke - It’s an irrefutable truth! “Let me tell you something: Every one of these careless words is going to come back to haunt you. There will be a time of Reckoning. Words are powerful; take them seriously” (TBCL). Aside the truth of giving an account on the day of judgment, words are so powerful - they produce - and come back either to calm or harm you. So, don’t be careless with your words. Make sure you speak words that are in agreement with God’s Word only, Matt 12:37. Avoid destructive and empty words - either to yourself or others.
prayer: 1. Ask God to be glorified daily in your life 2. Take authority over the spirit of looseness 3. Commit your day’s activities into God’s hand.

title: : FLEE ALL IDLE WORDS
body: : FLEE ALL IDLE WORDS “God. has given us this ministry of restoring relationships” (GWT) 2 Cor 5:18 Conflict is no strange experience in human affairs. It comes in different ways and sizes in all human dwellings - church, home, neighbourhood, school, work place - for different reasons. We need to always avoid it. But when it comes, we need to resolve it. BBE puts 2 Cor 5:18 thus, “But all things are of God, who. has given to us the work of making peace.” Read Matt 5:9. Here are divine blueprints in restoring broken relationship: 1. Talk to God before taking to the person - prayer changes situation and men alike. 2. Make the first move for peaceful settlement. It doesn’t matter whether you are the one who is right or not. Just seek for peace, Matt 5:23-24. 3. Admit where you’re wrong and confess your part of the matter. Confession is one the most powerful tools for restoring broken relationship. Confess - don’t judge, don’t condemn and don’t criticize - settle things amicably, read 1 John 1:9. 3, 1 John 1:7.
prayer: Father, I ask for Your divine assistance to always follow biblical order of restoring broken relationship in the name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : REST ORING BROKEN RELA TIONSHIP
verse: them that put their trust in him” (KJV) Pro 30:5
body: : REST ORING BROKEN RELA TIONSHIP “Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him” (KJV) Pro 30:5 Purity begins with asking. “And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do. If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it” (KJV) John 14:1314. “And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you. ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full” (KJV) John 16:23-24. Purity continues with believing - faith is the key to living a pure life. “And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive” (KJV) Matt 21:22. It cumulates in confession - possession is rooted in profession. Positive confession based on the Word is a powerful tool to living a pure life. “That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved” (KJV) Rom 10:9. Sing and say this piece repeatedly, “Wash me, O Lamb of God, Wash me from sin! By Thine atoning blood, O make me clean.”
prayer: Lord, I love to be clean. Make me clean and pure within and without. Wash me and make me whiter than snow by the blood of Jesus.

title: : ABC OF PURITY
body: : ABC OF PURITY “. your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost. ye are not your own?” (KJV) 1 Cor 6:19 Rom 14:7-8 says, “For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself. For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's” (KJV). Your body does not belong to you; it belongs to Him. Your body is made for Him and His praise. “For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's” (KJV). Believers are expected to honour God – we have no right over ourselves. “ Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?” (KJV) 1 Cor 3:16. Your body is His temple and it must be kept undefiled for His continual dwelling, 1 Cor 3:17. We are bought for a price by Christ’s precious blood. We are His by redemption and we can't afford to live for gratification of the flesh. In ancient time, the servant was completely the property of his master. And so, we are completely the sole property of the Master - Jesus! CONFESSION I will always keep my body undefiled for Your continual dwelling. [Say it repeatedly and wholeheartedly]

title: : YOUR BODY BELONGS TO HIM
body: : YOUR BODY BELONGS TO HIM “The one thing I ask of the LORD - the thing I seek most - is to live in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, delighting in the LORD's perfections and meditating in his Temple” (NLT) Ps 27:4 You have to learn to aspire to acquire - that’s the spiritual law of growth. David was a king and had all that life could afford humanly speaking but he wanted something more. He needed God and everything about God. When God becomes what you want most you have much more than you bargain for. With your quest your help is guaranteed. “Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money.” (KJV) Isa 55:1-2. You’ve dwelt long enough in this realm. It’s high time you stepped into the next realm. Quest for more! More spiritual strength. Go in hot pursuit of God. “But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint” (KJV) Isa 40:31.
confession: I’m stepping out into my next realm. I am spending days in fasting and praying to birth a new dawn. As I seek Him, I will not be denied.

title: : QUEST
body: : QUEST “. See that you go on growing in the Lord, and become strong and vigorous in the truth. Let your lives overflow with joy.” (TLB) Col 2:7 Our ultimate aspiration in this life should be character-growth and not just charisma-growth. As good as charisma is, it’s incomparable with character. God’s great goal is our growth - growing in Christlike attitude and His nature. “God spoke: "Let us make human beings in our image, make them reflecting our nature." God created human beings; he created them godlike, Reflecting God's nature.” (TBCL) Gen 1:26-27. You’re made to reflect His nature. Christlikeness is the goal! Matt 11:29-30 says, “Walk with me and work with me - watch how I do it. Learn the unforced rhythms of grace. I won't lay anything heavy or ill-fitting on you. Keep company with me and you'll learn to live freely and lightly.” (TBCL). That’s all it takes to be Christlike - walking with Him, making Him your Mentor and learning of His grace rhythms - by so doing you flow freely in His character.
confession: Ready to walk with Him more than ever before. God’s great goal remains my goal - character growth that cumulate in His likeness.

title: : CREA TED TO BE CHRISTLIKE
body: : CREA TED TO BE CHRISTLIKE “. let us grow up in every way and in all things into Him Who is the Head, [even] Christ (the Messiah, the Anointed One)” (AMP) Eph 4:15 Your daily growth is a necessity - a must happen - He loves it, He cherishes it, He seeks it daily - He is happy seeing you grow in Christ daily. TBCL speaks of Eph 4:15 thus, “God wants us to grow up, to know the whole truth and tell it in love - like Christ in everything. We take our lead from Christ, who is the source of everything we do.” Growth takes a lifetime - it’s not spontaneous - give God free access to keep perfecting His work in you. Don’t struggle in His hand or else your peers or people around would mold you into their own individual images. “Don't become so well-adjusted to your culture that you fit into it without even thinking. Instead, fix your attention on God. You'll be changed from the inside out. Readily recognize what he wants from you.” Rom 12:2. You’re created to be Christlike!
prayer: Dear heavenly Father, thanks so much for this revelation. As the Spirit of God works within me, I will continue to be more and more like You. Reflecting Your grace and manifesting Your glory daily in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : GROWING UP IN HIM DAIL Y
body: : GROWING UP IN HIM DAIL Y “For not ourselves do we preach, but Christ JesusLord.” (YLT) 2 Cor 4:5 Don’t just live it - preach it - preach purity and His presence. There are thousands and millions around us who are still wallowing willfully in wickedness and wantonness. Tell them of His love to cleanse and make free. This is the noble assignment committed into every believer’s hand. Preach Him in your office. Preach Him in your school. Preach Him in the neighbourhood. Preach Him everywhere you go! Besides, create time to preach Jesus in the hospitals, market places, villages and many other places. Where you have busy schedules, send or support others. Just make sure that through you others are hearing of the love of Christ every day, Col 1:28. Think of how many lives you could help transform via this classic devotional. You could sponsor free distribution in places of your choice, Matt 24:14. Let the salvation of men be your daily passion. CONFESSION I’ll tell the world, that I’m a Christian, I’m not ashamed, His name to bear; I’ll tell the world, that I’m a Christian, I’ll take Him with me anywhere. I’ll tell the world, that He’s my Saviour. I AM SET TO PREACH JESUS EVERYWHERE.

title: : PREACH HIS PURITY AND PRESENCE
verse: “. and David waxed stronger and stronger.”
body: : PREACH HIS PURITY AND PRESENCE “. and David waxed stronger and stronger.” (ASV) 2 Sam 3:1 The house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker, lost places, lost men, sunk in its reputation, grew less, and was foiled in every engagement. But the house of David grew stronger and stronger. “The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger” (KJV) Job 17:9. Keep your spirit alive in spite of challenges, confrontations, trials and tribulations. keep the going going. Don’t give up! Don’t give in! Wax strong in the Spirit! Pro 4:18 says, “But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day” (KJV). The Lord’s command is about being strong. You can take advantage of God’s strength to strengthen yourself. “Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might. Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil” (KJV) Eph 6:1011.
confession: No, the devil can’t win the battle. My spirit is waxing stronger and stronger. Behold I go from strength to strength and from conquest to conquest. Victory is mine everyday!

title: : W AXING STRONGER AND STRONGER IN THE SPIRIT
verse: liest down, and when thou risest up” (DT) Deut6:7
body: : W AXING STRONGER AND STRONGER IN THE SPIRIT “And thou shalt impress them on thy sons, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou goest on the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up” (DT) Deut6:7 “. bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord” (KJV) Eph 6:4. Fatherhood or motherhood is no small task. It’s a call to a lifetime commitment of training. In training the children, teach them all of God’s ordinances - about sexual abstinence and how they can withstand pressure both from within and without, Pro 22:6. Apart from the training, speak right words into their lives. Pray for them continually. And don’t forget to live by example. And to every child, “Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him.” Pro 3:5-8. Read 1 Cor 6:18. Flee all uncleanness and take the oath of purity on your life. If you’ve been cut in the web of fornication or immoral practices, confess it to God and stand by His Word. Keep yourself in His will. Wait for your time while you are busy for Him.
confession: Fornication and all uncleanness shall not be made mention about me. I stand for purity, spirit soul and body - [Say it repeatedly].

title: : TEACH THEM TO TAKE AN OA TH OF PURITY
verse: see no unclean thing in thee.” (KJV) Deut 23:14
body: : TEACH THEM TO TAKE AN OA TH OF PURITY “For the LORD thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp. therefore shall thy camp be holy: that he see no unclean thing in thee.” (KJV) Deut 23:14 Cleanliness is no human idea. It is God’s. He treasures cleanliness. TEV reads, “Keep your camp ritually clean, because the LORD your God is with you in your camp to protect you and to give you victory over your enemies. Do not do anything indecent that would cause the LORD to turn his back on you.” God wants your camp - compound, home and even your body - clean continually. Cleanliness reduces the risk of disease, keeps you healthy, prevents food poison and boosts mental health. “Cleaning offers a sense of satisfaction. The physical effort required for dusting, scrubbing, vacuuming and wiping may ward off depression according to a 2008 study published in the British Journal of Sports Medicine. This is because it helps reduce stress and anxiety while also offering a sense of accomplishment. Laundry, yard work. organizing are other good options.” Read Pro 3:23-24.
confession: I choose to keep myself, home and surrounding clean. I’ll always maintain the rules of hygiene. And sickness shall be far away from me.

title: : CLEANLINESS IS AKIN TO GODLINESS
verse: Jesus our Lord, I die daily” (KJV) 1 Cor 15:31
body: : CLEANLINESS IS AKIN TO GODLINESS “I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily” (KJV) 1 Cor 15:31 Speaking emphatically, Jesus, in John 12:24 asserted, “Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a grain of wheat fall into the earth and die, it abideth by itself alone; but if it die, it beareth much fruit” (ASV). The secret of much fruit bearing is not in living - It’s in dying - we must die to be truly fruitful. “Listen carefully: Unless a grain of wheat is buried in the ground, dead to the world, it is never any more than a grain of wheat. But if it is buried, it sprouts and reproduces itself many times over” (TBCL). The secret of victory and conquest is in dying daily. Dying to self in all its ramifications. John 14:25-26 says, “In the same way, anyone who holds on to life just as it is destroys that life. But if you let it go, reckless in your love, you'll have it forever, real and eternal.” Paul, in his second epistle to the Corinthians, wrote in chapter 4 verse 10, “Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body” (KJV). I leave you with Rom 8:17-19 for your personal digestion.
confession: I join to declare this day - I die daily to self and sin! Self shall not lord it over me.

title: : DYING DAIL Y
body: : DYING DAIL Y “That I may know him and I the power of his resurrection, and. becoming like him in his death” (ESV) Phil 3:10 How sweet to sing, “You make my life so beautiful And as You are, You have made me here on earth, There’s nothing greater than this, That’s why I love You forever more. I want more of You I want more of You, Jesus The more I know You The more I want to know You Jesus, more of You. More of You, More of You, More of You, Jesus more of You, More of You, More of You, More of You Jesus, more of You.” Amplified of Phil 3:10 goes, “[For my determined purpose is] that I may know Him [that I may progressively become more deeply and intimately acquainted with Him.” Find time for personal spiritual retreat where you could give Him the needed attention. Much more, find time to attend enriching seminars for more and more of God. Read Deut 4:29 and 2 Chro 16:11.
confession: I’m pressing on the upward way, New heights I’m gaining every day; Still praying as I onward bound, “Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.” Lord, lift me up, and let me stand By faith on Canaan’s tableland; A higher plane than I have found, Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.

title: : I W ANT MORE AND MORE OF JESUS
verse: loved me, and gave himself for me” (KJV) Gal 2:20
body: : I W ANT MORE AND MORE OF JESUS I am crucified. nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me” (KJV) Gal 2:20 “So I am not the one living now - it is Christ living in me. I still live in my body, but I live by faith in the Son of God. He is the one who loved me and gave himself to save me” (ERV). Paul left the scene for Christ to be seen and made manifest in and through him. “Likewise you also, reckon yourselves to be dead indeed to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord. Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts. And do not present your members as instruments of unrighteousness to sin.” (NKJV) Rom 6:11-13. Allow Christ’s reign and dominion over your life. Get this done by disallowing the control of sin over your thought and action. Always switch off the sinful thought and switch on the godly thought. “If then you have been raised up with Christ, keep seeking the things above. Set your mind on the things above.” (KJV) Col 3:1-5.
confession: I have been crucified with Christ; and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me.

title: : NOT I
verse: “And what I say to you, I say to all: Watch!” (NKJV)
body: : NOT I “And what I say to you, I say to all: Watch!” (NKJV) MK 13:37 Gregoreuo is the Greek for the word watch meaning to keep awake or to be vigilant. NT contains 22 occurrences of gregoreuo. All speak of the need for watchfulness. No one knows when Jesus will come. Our earnest prayer should be: “When He shall come with trumpet sound, Oh, may I then in Him be found; In Him, my righteousness, alone, Faultless to stand before the throne.” “But take heed to yourselves, lest haply your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day come on you suddenly as a snare” (ASV) Luke 21:34. Read Rom 13:12. This world will soon be gone. While waiting, three things to be done: 1. Live a worthy life - You’ve got to be worthy to be qualified [Col 1:10] 2. Live a working life. Be involved in the kingdom work [John 9:4] 3. Live a watchful life [Matt 25:13].
confession: My hope is built on nothing less, Than Jesus Christ, my righteousness; I dare not trust the sweetest frame, But wholly lean on Jesus’ name. On Christ, the solid Rock, I stand; All other ground is sinking sand. [Say it. Sing it repeatedly]

title: : LIVING A WATCHFUL LIFE
body: : LIVING A WATCHFUL LIFE “Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God” (NWB) 2 Cor 7:1. Peter wrote, “Show respect for everyone. Love Christians everywhere. Fear God and honor the government” (TLB) 1 Pet 2:17. keep to God’s holy reverence. “. by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil” (KJV) Job 16:6. This is not phobia - a kind of extreme or irrational fear that brings to bondage. This kind makes you wise in all things - knowing what to do and what not to do in relation to God and fellow humans, Ps 111:10. What then is the fear of God? “The fear of the LORD is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way.” (KJV) Pro 8:13. Here are the benefits of the fear of the Lord: “In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence.” (KJV) Pro 14:26. “The fear of the LORD prolongeth days.” (KJV) Pro 10:27. “The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life.” (KJV) Pro 14:27. “By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life” (KJV) Pro 22:4; Eccl 12:13-14.
prayer: Father, I ask that Your fear be planted in me. Cause me to always bring honour to You in Jesus mighty and precious name, Amen.

title: : PERFECTING HOLINESS IN THE FEAR OF GOD
body: : PERFECTING HOLINESS IN THE FEAR OF GOD “But the fruit that the Spirit produces in a person's life is love.” (ERV) Gal 5:22 We’ll be looking at the fruit of the Spirit - love - the very spirit and soul of true religion. “Put on therefore, as [the] elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of compassion, kindness, lowliness, meekness, longsuffering; forbearing one another, and forgiving one another.” (DBY) Col 3:12-14. The fruit of the Spirit is the work of the Holy Spirit in you. The fruit is not yours; it’s of the Spirit and from the Spirit. Bearing the fruit of the Spirit is a proof of His presence in you. Where there is no fruit of the Spirit, there is certainly no Holy Spirit there. It's as clear as that! The Spirit produces these character traits in us. They are the by-product of Christ's regeneration in us. We don't grow into the fruit of the Spirit; we only grow in it as we grow in our relationship with God. The fruit of the SPIRIT leads the way and leads to everlasting life. The Spirit produces the F-R-U-I-T; we provide G-O-O-D N-U-TU-R-I-N-G. Love forms a firm foundation for all other fruit. This is the hallmark of Christianity that separates saints from sinners.
prayer: Father, I give it all it takes to grow in love, I ask for Your enablement in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : LOVE – THE FRUIT OF THE SPIRIT
verse: “. ” (KJV) for the joy of the LORD is your strength
body: : LOVE – THE FRUIT OF THE SPIRIT “. ” (KJV) for the joy of the LORD is your strength Neh 8:10 “For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands” (KJV) Isa 55:12. Joy is the calm delight of the spirit engineered by the Spirit. It’s void of anxiety. It’s the kind that makes you cool, collected and confident in spite of test and trial. Joy is not dependent on what you’ve gotten but on what you’ve given. This shows the difference between joy and happiness. Happiness depends on the happenings; Joy depends on the harmony of your spirit with the Spirit of God. “For the kingdom of God is. righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost” (KJV) Rom 14:17. You can experience the FULLNESS OF JOY! Acts 13:52. Yes, you can! You can experience the in-filling of divine joy – everyday, every hour and every single moment!
confession: The joy of the Holy Spirit is my strength. So, resentment, unhappiness and moodiness has no place in my life. The Holy Spirit takes His full place in me causing me to brim with joy and be filled more and more with His fullness.
